units: <cite ref="Beitzah 24a:9">Bets. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>כל … ומטי לה בחד ש׳</he> (Ar. <he>שהיא</he>) when one running after an animal gets it with one bend (the space being too small to allow an escape).

<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 7:1">ib. VII, 1</cite> <he>והרכין</he>) <he>ודילמא ש׳ דלאו לאו נקטיה</he> maybe he was seized by spasms, making him bend his head in the way of one indicating dissent; <he>ש׳ דהן הן</he> making him bend in the way of one bowing the head in assent.
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 7:1">Ib.</cite> <he>ש׳ דסירוגין</he> alternate spasms of the head accidentally corresponding to assent and dissent respectively.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 22:5">Targ. Y. Deut. XXII, 5</cite> (ed. Vien. <cite ref="U00868"><he>שֵׁיחַיָא</he></cite>, corr. acc.).—Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᵈ top <he>אסור למיתן … תחות ש׳</he> (not <he>דלא מיתן</he>) it is forbidden to put coins into the mouth … or a loaf under the arm-pit; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:3:13">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵃ</cite> bot. <cite ref="U01971"><he>בי ש׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 6:6:5">Y. Snh. VI, 23ᶜ</cite> <he>הוה תחות שִׁיחְיֵה וכ׳</he> had a loaf under his arm, and it fell down &c.
